metaDescription: Order custom golf products with carabiner clips for easy attachment. Perfect for tournaments and corporate gifts at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Carabiner clips turn standard golf gear into portable accessories that clip directly to a golf bag or belt loop. Whether you are outfitting a company tournament or rewarding top clients, these additions ensure the branded towel, tool, or tee carrier stays secure and accessible. From the Rugged 7-in-1 Golf Tool to the Maggy Magnetic Waffle Towel, each item gains practical convenience with the carabiner attachment.
